description: Discover stock comparison candidates for one exact Bullrun ticker using stored industry or sector classification. Discloses the chosen classification, country preference, deterministic selection order, scan cap and issuer/listing exclusions. Excludes the subject, secondary listings and identifiable duplicate issuers/share classes. Returns compact stored multiples/growth plus ready-to-use compare_stocks arguments. Classification peers are not verified competitors or a financial-similarity ranking; no generated peers or paid graph discovery. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

limit.description: Maximum peers. compare_stocks supports the subject plus at most four selected peers.

matchBy.description: auto uses exact stored industry when present, otherwise sector. It does not silently widen an empty industry result to the entire sector.

sameCountryOnly.description: Restrict to the subject's exact stored country. Otherwise same-country candidates are shown first, followed by other countries.

ticker.description: Exact native Bullrun equity ticker. Use search_stocks first for a company name, ISIN or Yahoo-format symbol.

name: find_stock_peers
title: Discover comparable stock candidates
